name: ethylhexyl methoxycinnamate + zinc oxide
uses: Helps prevent sunburn. ​Protects scars from UV exposure, which may help reduce discoloration and further skin damage.
otcwarn: Do not use on damaged or broken skin or open wounds. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away. Stop use and ask a doctor if rash or irritation occurs.

src.label: MURASAKI BEAUTY Silicence Scar Gel SPF 30
